text: （更新）我最想给你说的一句话是，把你最大头的精力，拿去研究怎么提升自己对抗风险的能力，而不是用这种精力来研究男人到底都是什么心态，真面目是什么，到底怎么分辨渣男，到底怎么鉴别男人对我是原始欲望还是“真正的爱情”。
en: (Updated) The one thing I most want to tell you is this: take the bulk of your energy and devote it to studying how to improve your own ability to guard against risk, rather than using that energy to study what men's mindsets really are, what their true natures are, how on earth to tell apart scumbags, and how on earth to tell whether a man's feelings for me are primal desire or "true love".

text: 这个对抗风险的能力包括经济方面的能力和心态，而心态是其中更重要的一个方面。
en: This ability to guard against risk includes economic capability and mindset, and mindset is the more important of the two.

text: 我能理解你们面对男人的时候的那种不安全感，害怕受伤，害怕被欺骗，但解决这种不安全感的究极手段，就是提升个人能力和改变个人心态，而非“去看清男人的真面目”，这你是看不清的，且不说千人千面，一人也有千面，你要怎么样才算是看清？
en: I can understand the insecurity you feel when facing men, the fear of being hurt, the fear of being deceived, but the ultimate way to resolve this insecurity is to improve your personal capability and change your personal mindset, not to "see clearly men's true faces" — which you cannot see clearly. Not to mention that a thousand people have a thousand faces, and even one person has a thousand faces; by what measure would you count as having seen clearly?

text: 有的姑娘喜欢讨伐的渣男，也可能只是对作天作地的姑娘很渣，等这个男人遇上一个温柔自立，沟通良好的姑娘，可能又变成了什么责任都能承担的男子汉，你今天嫁了的五好男人，也有可能十年之后出轨了，而他在结婚的那一刻和这十年之中，对你的忠心和责任也可以是毫不掺假的。
en: The scumbag some girls like to denounce may simply be scummy only towards girls who are endlessly dramatic and unreasonable; when this man meets a gentle, independent, and well-communicating girl, he may turn into a real man who can shoulder any responsibility. The "five-good man" you married today might also have an affair ten years later, yet at the moment of marriage and throughout those ten years his loyalty and sense of duty towards you could be utterly genuine.

text: 所处的时间变化，环境变化，面对的人的变化，都有可能导致同样的人展现出来不一样的面，哪一个是“真”面目？
en: Changes in the time one is in, changes in one's environment, and changes in the people one faces can all lead the same person to show a different face; which one is the "true" face?

text: 他面对你的时候是什么样，一半取决于他本身是什么样的人，另一半取决于你自己是什么样的人。
en: What he is like when facing you depends half on what kind of person he himself is, and the other half on what kind of person you yourself are.

text: 所以说有的人遇不到对的人原因就在这里。
en: So this is why some people never meet the right person.

text: 还有，想要割裂爱情和性去看问题的话，这事就永远无解了。
en: Also, if you try to separate love from sex in looking at the matter, it will forever be insoluble.

text: 爱情自身也是一种原始欲望，被现代价值观各种镀金各种神圣化，但本质上还是激素在控制，性也一样。
en: Love itself is also a kind of primal desire, gilded and sanctified by modern values in every way, but essentially it is still hormones in control, and so is sex.

text: 它们是不会被割裂的东西，男人追求你是原始欲望，不代表只有性欲而没有爱。
en: They are things that cannot be separated; a man pursuing you being primal desire does not mean there is only sexual desire and no love.

text: 如果你想要一段，完全剥离性的所谓真正爱情，不好意思，那应该没有。
en: If you want a so-called true love that is completely stripped of sex, I am afraid there is none.

text: 同时还有一件很重要的事情，“真正的爱情”并不等于“永恒的婚姻”或者“永远的负责”，最好码清楚这一点。
en: At the same time there is another very important thing: "true love" does not equal "eternal marriage" or "eternal responsibility", and it is best to be clear about this.

text: 换句话说，知乎上所有提出“如何鉴别渣男”问题的姑娘们，你们的问题全部都没有答案。
en: In other words, all you girls on Zhihu who have raised the question "how to identify scumbags" — none of your questions have an answer.

text: 你们的目的都想要一个一生一世永不变的男人，这世上没有任何办法，能让你鉴别出来这样一个人，所有的鉴别方法，都受个人观念和环境的限制，任何办法鉴别出来的结果，换个环境，结果都可能不一样。
en: Your aim is all to want a man who will never change for life; there is no method in this world that can let you identify such a person. All methods of identification are limited by personal outlook and environment, and the result identified by any method might be different in a different environment.

text: 或者说根本就不存在这样一个人，事物永远在前进，永远在变，人永远不知道明天会发生什么。
en: Or rather, such a person simply does not exist; things are forever moving forward, forever changing, and one never knows what tomorrow will bring.

text: 能够彻底地，完全地解决这个问题的办法只有我说的这一种，在你完全有能力可以对自己负责任的时候，这世上将永无渣男，当一个男人的背叛和离开，已经不是一件很致命的事情了，你还需要用尽吃奶的力气，费尽所有的心思去鉴别所谓渣男吗？
en: The only way to resolve this problem thoroughly and completely is the one I have described: when you are fully capable of being responsible for yourself, there will forever be no scumbags in this world. When a man's betrayal and departure are no longer a fatal matter, do you still need to expend every ounce of your strength and rack your brains to identify so-called scumbags?

text: 那我来稍微说一下什么叫做“提升自己对抗风险的能力”。
en: Then let me briefly explain what is meant by "improving your ability to guard against risk".

text: 就是些干条一样的观念而已，这些未必在你看了之后，就能顺利变成你的思想，我想我做不到这一点，因为这些都基于我的个人经历和思考，而你可能没经历过我经历的事情。
en: They are just a few bare principles; these may not smoothly turn into your own way of thinking after you have read them. I do not think I can achieve that, because they are all based on my personal experiences and reflections, and you may not have been through what I have been through.

text: 所以说，我不能保证你看了这些，就一定能够提升你自己对抗风险的能力，但如果能够引发你对这件事更深入的思考，那也不是完全没用的。
en: So, I cannot guarantee that after reading these you will certainly improve your ability to guard against risk, but if they can prompt you to think more deeply about this matter, then they are not entirely useless.

text: 经济方面，其实用不着家底殷实大富大贵。
en: In terms of finances, you actually need not come from a wealthy or affluent family.

text: 1.你要有个工作，对，最最低要求的也要是社会要求的那种，“能养得起自己的”，上不封顶。
en: 1. You must have a job; yes, even the bare minimum is the kind society requires — one that "can support yourself" — with no upper limit.

text: 这一点的重要性毋庸置疑，不到“不放弃工作就得死”的时候，不要放弃工作。
en: The importance of this goes without saying; do not give up work until the point where "you would have to die if you did not give it up".

text: 而且在工作上一定要尽力，若有晋升机会最好请不要错过。
en: Moreover, you must do your utmost at work; if there is a promotion opportunity, it is best not to miss it.

text: 2.你自己起码是个基本观念，基础道德没什么大问题的人，比如说，别赚着4K的月薪，觉得穿8K的鞋，拿2W的包才是“有面子”，才是“女人该过的生活”，那这样的话你的工作很难是一份“养得起你自己的工作”。
en: 2. You yourself must at least be someone whose basic outlook and fundamental morals are not seriously flawed. For example, do not earn a monthly salary of 4K yet feel that wearing 8K shoes and carrying a 20K bag is what counts as "having face" or "the life a woman ought to live" — because if so, your job will hardly be one that "can support yourself".

text: 心态方面，思考能力和自省能力是一切的基础，思考你能思考的所有东西。
en: In terms of mindset, the ability to think and the ability to self-reflect are the foundation of everything; think about all that you can think about.

text: 1.你和男人的差异，其实并没有你被教育的/你所认为的/你所想象的那么巨大。
en: 1. The difference between you and men is in fact not as vast as you were taught, as you believe, or as you imagine.

text: 多了解一下性别观念是怎么形成的。
en: Learn more about how gender concepts are formed.

text: 所以其实真相是，你没那么脆弱，也原本没那么强的依赖心，男人也没那么不需要爱情，不需要关怀。
en: So the truth is, you are not that fragile, nor did you originally have such a strong dependence; men are not so averse to love and care either.

text: 2.事物都是过程的集合，人生的意义在于经历，在于你认识过的每一个人，建立的每一段关系，体验到的每一种情感。
en: 2. Things are all collections of processes; the meaning of life lies in experience — in every person you have known, every relationship you have built, and every emotion you have felt.

text: 比如恋爱这件事，我所经历过的恋爱里，我和他一起走过的那些时间，一起做过的那些事，体会到过的那些怦然心动，幸福甜蜜，还有我在这段恋爱中获得的个人成长，就是这段恋爱的意义，不是结了婚，才是有意义的恋爱，没结就毫无意义。
en: Take romantic relationships, for instance. In the relationships I have experienced, the time he and I spent together, the things we did together, the flutterings of the heart and the happiness and sweetness we felt, and the personal growth I gained from that relationship — that is the meaning of that relationship. It is not that only a relationship that ends in marriage is meaningful, while one that does not is utterly meaningless.

text: 3.不完美是生活的常态，那些美中不足不是因为你做错了什么事才出现的，就算是，你作为一个人，也不可能做对人生中所有的事情，所以不完美就是无法避免的生活的“真面目”，生活本就是痛苦与幸福相伴而生，你不可能只体会到其中的正面而避免所有反面。
en: 3. Imperfection is the norm of life; those small shortcomings do not appear because you did something wrong — and even if they did, as a human being you could not do everything in life correctly. Therefore imperfection is the unavoidable "true face" of life. Life is inherently born of pain and happiness together; you cannot experience only its positive side while avoiding all its negative side.

text: 我可以接受生活不太完美，爱情不太完美。
en: I can accept that life is imperfect, and that love is imperfect.

text: 以上是基础的，旨在解决人生的基本哲学问题。
en: The above is foundational, aimed at resolving the basic philosophical questions of life.

text: 接下来是高阶的，旨在获得同理心，获得共情的能力。
en: Next is the advanced part, aimed at gaining empathy and the capacity to relate to others' feelings.

text: 4.认识自己的变化。
en: 4. Recognise your own changes.

text: 有谁是二十多年来观念和需求从来没变过的？
en: Is there anyone whose outlook and needs have never changed over more than twenty years?

text: 那既然你从以前到现在有变化，那你从现在到将来，也就会有变化。
en: Well, since you have changed from the past to now, you will also change from now into the future.

text: 既然你会有变化，别人就也会有变化。
en: Since you will change, others will change too.

text: 5.认清人性的黑暗，最好的办法是反省和剖析自己的黑暗。
en: 5. To see clearly the darkness of human nature, the best method is to reflect on and analyse your own darkness.

text: 你没法进入他人内心知道他在想什么，但你会知道自己在想什么。
en: You cannot enter another's mind to know what they are thinking, but you can know what you yourself are thinking.

text: 在自己出现负面想法的时候看清自己的自私与贪婪，你就能知道别人也都是一样的。
en: When you have negative thoughts, see clearly your own selfishness and greed, and you will know that others are the same.

text: 要有此认知，你就会对别人那些不致命的黑暗面抱以理解，变得不会那么苛刻。
en: With this awareness, you will meet others' non-fatal dark sides with understanding, and become less harsh.

text: 6.人和人生活的环境不一样，受到的教育不一样，经历的事情不一样，就会产生不一样的想法和思维，人身上观念是有基础的，不是凭空产生的，评价人要放在其所处的环境中去评价。
en: 6. People live in different environments, receive different educations, and go through different experiences, which gives rise to different thoughts and ways of thinking. The outlook a person holds has a basis and does not arise from nothing; to judge a person, one must judge them within the environment they are in.

text: 以上是作为人的同理心，下面是你最关心的爱情问题，以目前的主流观念作为基准来评判的话，以下条目可能会显得三观不正，你选择性地看和接受，它们是我的个人准则，你可以没必要都同意。
en: The above is about empathy as a human being. Below is the matter of love you care about most. Judged against current mainstream values, the following points may seem to reflect misguided values; read and accept them selectively. They are my personal principles, and you need not agree with all of them.

text: 7.会变得不只是男人，还可能是你自己。
en: 7. It is not only men who will change; it could also be yourself.

text: 还没经历过人生波澜万丈的时候，别太坚信自己是唯一遗世独立的白莲花，普通人里没谁比谁高尚多少。
en: Before you have experienced the great turbulence of life, do not be too convinced that you are the only pure white lotus standing apart from the world; among ordinary people, no one is all that nobler than another.

text: 8.男人为女人负责是基于当前生产力所产生的社会分工的观念，而非任何环境下都“天然正确的”。
en: 8. A man being responsible for a woman is a notion based on the social division of labour produced by current productive forces, not something "naturally correct" in every circumstance.

text: 9.我给一个人表白，他是不是就必须答应我，回应我，爱我？
en: 9. If I confess my feelings to someone, must they accept me, respond to me, and love me?

text: 必然不是，我爱一个人，但他爱我，或者不爱我，都是正常的，正当的。
en: Certainly not. I love someone, but whether they love me or do not love me is both normal and proper.

text: 他从不爱我变得爱我，从爱我变得不爱我，都是会有可能发生的。
en: That he goes from not loving me to loving me, or from loving me to not loving me, are both possibilities that can occur.

text: 10.我为什么有天然的权利成为另外一个人绝对的唯一，成为另外一个人生活中永远最优先的事物？
en: 10. Why do I have a natural right to be another person's absolute sole one, to be the forever top priority in another person's life?

text: 当然，在问为什么之前，要问问我有没有这种权利。
en: Of course, before asking why, I should ask whether I even have such a right.

text: 我曾经因为你这么做，非常难过，可是我毕竟已经不再是一个自以为是的孩子了，我明白了，凡是人总有取舍，你取了你认为最重要的东西，舍弃了我，这只是你的选择而已，若是我因为没有被选择，就心生怨恨，那这世间岂不是有太多不可原谅之处。
en: I once felt deeply saddened because you acted this way, but I am after all no longer a self-righteous child. I understand that all people must choose and give things up; you took what you deemed most important and let go of me — that is merely your choice. If I were to harbour resentment simply because I was not chosen, would there not be far too much in this world that is unforgivable?

text: 毕竟谁也没有责任以我为先，以我为重，无论我如何希望也不能强求。
en: After all, no one is obliged to put me first or to hold me as most important; no matter how much I wish it, I cannot force it.

text: 我之所以这么待你，是因为我愿意，若能以此换回同样的诚心，固然可喜，若是没有，我也没有什么可后悔的。
en: The reason I treat you this way is that I am willing; if I can thereby win back the same sincerity, that is of course delightful, but if not, I have nothing to regret.

text: ——《琅琊榜》·萧景睿
en: — Nirvana in Fire · Jingrui Xiao

text: 我以我最大的热情和最浓烈的爱去换取同样的东西，如果换不来，虽然伤心，但这却是可以接受的结果。
en: I exchange my greatest passion and most intense love for the same in return; if I cannot, though I am sad, it is an acceptable outcome.

text: 所以，我爱就直说爱，想念就直说想念，想见就自己起程去见，我可以先发短信联系，有矛盾先道歉，先包容，先开启谈话避免冷战，可以倾诉也可以倾听，可以安慰也可以开导。
en: So, if I love, I say I love plainly; if I miss, I say I miss plainly; if I want to meet, I set off myself to meet. I can be the first to text to keep in touch; when there is conflict, I apologise first, tolerate first, and start the conversation first to avoid the silent treatment. I can confide and I can listen; I can comfort and I can offer counsel.

text: 可以自己主动安排约会，自己为饭钱买单，自己开房。
en: I can take the initiative to arrange dates myself, pay for the meal myself, and book the room myself.

text: 11.我想要爱情带来的幸福体验，喜欢在见他之前买一大堆东西收拾打扮时候的雀跃心情，喜欢和他一起做所有开心的事情。
en: 11. I want the happy experiences that love brings; I like the buoyant, joyful mood of buying a heap of things and getting dolled up before seeing him, and I like doing all the happy things together with him.

text: 但我不是不会痛苦，只是可以接受而已。
en: But it is not that I cannot feel pain; I merely can accept it.

text: 我就算是在拥有了以上所有心态和认知之后，还是因为一个男人不爱我断断续续痛苦过一年以上。
en: Even after possessing all the mindsets and understandings above, I still suffered on and off for over a year because a man did not love me.

text: 但尽管如此，我依然想要和他在一起相处的时候的那些感觉，依然觉得能遇到他我很幸运。
en: But despite this, I still wanted those feelings of being with him, and still felt lucky to have met him.

text: 要么什么都没有，要么就幸福痛苦都得有。
en: Either have nothing at all, or have both happiness and pain.

text: 我就要选后者。
en: I choose the latter.

text: 12.应对痛苦没什么太好的方法，我的选择就是颓废一小段时间，放飞自我随便哭。
en: 12. There is no particularly good method for coping with pain; my choice is to let myself go for a short spell, cut loose and cry as I please.

text: 13.当然，这不是我会永远犯贱，永远都可以只付出不求任何回报的意思。
en: 13. Of course, this does not mean I will forever debase myself, forever able only to give without asking for any return.

text: 长久得不到回报的付出，会让原本浓厚的爱情本身变得越来越冷（这不是我自己能控制的事情），当爱情激素都退去的时候，我就会不爱了，然后我就可以离开这个不爱我的人了。
en: Long-unrewarded giving will make what was once deep love itself grow colder and colder (this is not something I can control), and when the love hormones have all receded, I will stop loving, and then I can leave this person who does not love me.

text: 所以我谈恋爱的两种情况就是，我一开始的爱都是一样的，如我所说，热情而浓烈，如果能换来同样的爱，这段恋爱会维持很高质量且持续相当长的时间。
en: So the two situations of my romantic relationships are as follows: my love at the start is always the same — passionate and intense, as I have said. If it can win the same love in return, the relationship will maintain a very high quality and last quite a long time.

text: 如果不能换来同样的爱，不闹不强求，我会继续爱他，自己努力付出努力寻求在一起时候的开心，等我不爱了（一般不会太久），那就好聚好散。
en: If it cannot win the same love in return, I will not make a scene or force it; I will keep loving him, striving on my own to give and to seek the happiness of being together. When I no longer love him (usually not long), then we part on good terms.

text: 我经历开心了，那就值了。
en: As long as I have experienced happiness, it was worth it.

text: 14.我这些观念的产生，和我不把婚姻当事业，当人生结果，当生活保障有关。
en: 14. The formation of these ideas of mine is related to my not treating marriage as a career, as the outcome of life, or as a safeguard for living.

text: PS1：这些心态不会造成滥情/滥交/不care爱情/耽误婚姻/对爱情失去信心等结果。
en: PS1: These mindsets will not lead to results such as being promiscuous / having casual sex / not caring about love / delaying marriage / losing faith in love.

text: PS2：关于性别观念的构建，推荐去看一些社会学人类学的大神的各种回答，雨亦奇，Baolimeowmeow等。
en: PS2: Regarding the construction of gender concepts, I recommend reading various answers from some great masters of sociology and anthropology — Yu Yiqi, Baolimeowmeow, and others.

text: PS3：以上心态方面第二条观念，来自瘾小明：若一辈子没有赚大钱，当大官，和自己爱的人在一起（哪怕一次），活着能算有意义吗？
en: PS3: The second point in the mindset section above comes from Yin Xiaoming: if in one's whole life one never makes a fortune, never becomes a high official, and never stays with the one one loves (even once), can living be counted as meaningful?

text: 非瘾小明答主本身原话，只是我自己看过他的答案之后的个人感悟。
en: These are not Yin Xiaoming the answerer's exact words; they are merely my personal reflections after reading his answers.

text: PS4：关于事物都在运动，都在变化，稍微读读马克思，大学政治书就可以。
en: PS4: Regarding the idea that all things are in motion and constantly changing, you can just read a little Marx and your university politics textbooks.

text: PS5：若你想要一个明白自己的需求是什么，应对风险能力爆表，心态稳如泰山，面对所谓渣男应该战无不胜的典型例子，去看看CalistaWang。
en: PS5: If you want a typical example of someone who knows what her needs are, whose ability to handle risk is off the charts, whose mindset is as steady as Mount Tai, and who should be invincible against so-called scumbags, go and have a look at CalistaWang.

text: 其他的想看看心态成熟的女性是什么样的话，去看看菠菜，安雅等。
en: For others who want to see what a mentally mature woman is like, go and have a look at Bocai, Anya, and others.

text: 暂时就这么多，有值得讨论的再回复。
en: That is all for now; I will reply again if there is something worth discussing.
